description: This script fetches external pull request data from GitHub for the PyTorch repository, processes it, and uploads contribution statistics to an S3 bucket. It includes functions for URL fetching, JSON data retrieval, and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: _fetch_url
methods.description: Fetches a URL with optional headers, data, and method, handling HTTP errors.

methods.name: fetch_json
methods.description: Retrieves JSON data from a URL with optional query parameters and data payload.

methods.name: get_external_pr_data
methods.description: Collects pull request data from GitHub API over specified date ranges, filtering out certain users.
